main_text.l: VIxerunt teste Sigeberto circa annum 414. Sic
dicti, quod de prædestinatione & divina gratia
disputantes, asserer-ent pie viventibus non prodesse
bonorum operum laborem, si à Deo ad mortem or-
dinati fuissent, & impijs & peccatoribus non obesse
quæcunq; scelera & flagitia ab illis commissa, si Deus
illos ad vitam æternam prædestinasset, quæ assertio
& bonos à bonis operibus faciendis avocabat, & ma-
bus contra Pelagium multis in locis

page.notes: Ornamental printer's rules above "Prædestinati" and below the first paragraph are omitted. The word "electio-" is continued on the following page. The first word "Ixerunt" is printed with an enlarged initial V.
